summary: The change does what was asked. `deterministic_turn` in crates/athena-agent/src/fake.rs is now a 23-line match. It hands the Reader, Producer, Verifier and Planner arms to four new private functions: `reader_turn`, `producer_turn`, `verifier_turn` and `planner_turn`. The Critic, Steward, Audience and Auditor arms stay inline, and they are short. Reading the file shows the longest function is now `reader_turn`, about 101 lines, well under the 200-line limit. A whitespace-insensitive diff (`git diff HEAD~1 -w`) shows the change only moves code. JSON fields, literals, section headings, constants and the public signature are all unchanged. The only real edit is that rustfmt rewrapped one closure. No test was edited. I ran `cargo test -p athena-agent` in this snapshot: 72 tests passed and 2 were ignored, including all 6 fake.rs tests. CI recorded fmt, clippy and the full test suite as passing for this commit. CHANGELOG.md was also edited. Criterion 5's wording would exclude that file, but it is on the expected-deliverables list and the changelog default requires it, so it is in scope. There are no blocker or major findings.
